content.text:
No dedicated "writing a plugin" / `addUtilities`/`plugin()` API section exists — v4's docs cover custom utilities/variants only via `@utility`/`@custom-variant` CSS directives (`src/docs/adding-custom-styles.mdx`, "Adding custom utilities" §402 and "Adding custom variants" §672), with no JS `plugin()` API guide like v3 had.

This matches the upgrade guide (`src/docs/upgrade-guide.mdx`, "Adding custom utilities via @utility API"), confirming v4 shifted plugin-style extension to CSS-native `@utility`/`@variant` rather than the old `tailwind.config.js` `plugin()` function — so the old third-party plugin authoring guide has no direct v4 replacement in these docs.
